data.name: Recarbono
data.description: Recarbono Next, Lda is a young carbon removal project developer registered in Cascais, Portugal. Its registered purpose covers biomass processing and the production and sale of biochar. Its website describes building and operating biochar removal projects, and it publishes explainers on the EU CRCF.
